type_pp: ∀ {N m : ℕ}, 0 < N → 0 < GDT.R N m

name: GDT.Challenge.S_eq_filter_Ico
type_pp: ∀ (N L m : ℕ) (a : ℤ), GDT.S N L m a = Finset.filter (GDT.accepted N m a) (Finset.Ico 1 (L + 1))

name: GDT.Challenge.accepted_iff_coprime_R
type_pp:
∀ {N m : ℕ},
  0 < N →
    0 < m → ∀ {a : ℤ}, GDT.Admissible N m a → ∀ (n : ℕ), GDT.accepted N m a n ↔ ↑n ≡ a [ZMOD ↑m] ∧ n.gcd (GDT.R N m) = 1

name: GDT.Challenge.canonical_window_card_eq_range_coprime
type_pp:
∀ {N m : ℕ},
  0 < N →
    0 < m →
      ∀ {a : ℤ},
        GDT.Admissible N m a →
          {n ∈ Finset.Ico 0 (GDT.Tmin N m) | ↑n ≡ a [ZMOD ↑m] ∧ n.gcd (GDT.R N m) = 1}.card =
            {r ∈ Finset.range (GDT.R N m) | r.gcd (GDT.R N m) = 1}.card

name: GDT.Challenge.card_filter_Ico_split
type_pp:
∀ {P : ℕ → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred P] {a b c : ℕ},
  a ≤ b →
    b ≤ c →
      (Finset.filter P (Finset.Ico a c)).card =
        (Finset.filter P (Finset.Ico a b)).card + (Finset.filter P (Finset.Ico b c)).card

name: GDT.Challenge.coprime_add_mul_right
type_pp: ∀ {k c e : ℕ}, (k + e * c).Coprime e ↔ k.Coprime e

name: GDT.Challenge.coprime_d_R
type_pp: ∀ {N m : ℕ}, 0 < N → (GDT.d N m).Coprime (GDT.R N m)

name: GDT.Challenge.coprime_iff_coprime_rad
type_pp: ∀ {k n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → (k.Coprime n ↔ k.Coprime (GDT.rad n))

name: GDT.Challenge.coprime_m_R
type_pp: ∀ {N m : ℕ}, 0 < N → m.Coprime (GDT.R N m)

name: GDT.Challenge.coprime_of_modEq_natAbs
type_pp: ∀ {k : ℕ} {a : ℤ} {e : ℕ}, ↑k ≡ a [ZMOD ↑e] → a.natAbs.gcd e = 1 → k.Coprime e

name: GDT.Challenge.count_canonical_period
type_pp:
∀ {N m : ℕ},
  0 < N →
    0 < m →
      ∀ {a : ℤ},
        GDT.Admissible N m a →
          (Finset.filter (GDT.accepted N m a) (Finset.Ico 0 (GDT.Tmin N m))).card = (GDT.R N m).totient

name: GDT.Challenge.d_dvd_rad

name: GDT.Challenge.exists_accepted

name: GDT.Challenge.exists_coprime_R_neg_t_mod_p
type_pp:
∀ {N m : ℕ},
  0 < N →
    ∀ {p t : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ GDT.R N m → ¬p ∣ t → ∃ r < GDT.R N m, r.Coprime (GDT.R N m) ∧ ↑r ≡ -↑t [ZMOD ↑p]

name: GDT.Challenge.exists_repr_mod_R
type_pp: ∀ {N m : ℕ}, 0 < N → 0 < m → ∀ {a : ℤ} {r : ℕ}, r < GDT.R N m → ∃ n < GDT.Tmin N m, ↑n ≡ a [ZMOD ↑m] ∧ n % GDT.R N m = r

name: GDT.Challenge.exists_witness_avoiding_dvd

∀ {N m : ℕ},
  0 < N →
    0 < m →
      ∀ {a : ℤ}, GDT.Admissible N m a → ∀ {p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ GDT.R N m → ∃ n1, GDT.accepted N m a n1 ∧ ¬p ∣ n1

name: GDT.Challenge.gcd_mod_eq
type_pp: ∀ (n R : ℕ), n.gcd R = (n % R).gcd R

name: GDT.Challenge.gcd_with_N_iff_gcd_with_R
type_pp:
∀ {N m k : ℕ},
  0 < N → 0 < m → ∀ {a : ℤ}, GDT.Admissible N m a → ↑k ≡ a [ZMOD ↑m] → (k.gcd N = 1 ↔ k.gcd (GDT.R N m) = 1)

name: GDT.Challenge.gdt_correction_factor
type_pp: ∀ {N m : ℕ}, 0 < N → 0 < m → (GDT.R N m).totient * N * (GDT.d N m).totient = GDT.d N m * GDT.R N m * N.totient

name: GDT.Challenge.gdt_count_per_period
type_pp:
∀ {N m : ℕ},
  0 < N →
    0 < m →
      ∀ {a : ℤ},
        GDT.Admissible N m a →
          ∀ (b : ℕ), (Finset.filter (GDT.accepted N m a) (Finset.Ico b (b + GDT.Tmin N m))).card = (GDT.R N m).totient

name: GDT.Challenge.gdt_density
type_pp:
∀ {N m q s : ℕ},
  0 < N →
    0 < m →
      ∀ {a : ℤ},
        GDT.Admissible N m a →
          s < GDT.Tmin N m → (GDT.S N (q * GDT.Tmin N m + s) m a).card = q * (GDT.R N m).totient + (GDT.S N s m a).card

name: GDT.Challenge.gdt_empty
type_pp: ∀ {N m L : ℕ}, 0 < N → 0 < m → ∀ {a : ℤ}, ¬GDT.Admissible N m a → GDT.S N L m a = ∅

name: GDT.Challenge.gdt_minimal_period
type_pp:
∀ {N m : ℕ},
  0 < N → 0 < m → ∀ {a : ℤ}, GDT.Admissible N m a → ∀ {t : ℕ}, 0 < t → GDT.IsPeriod N m a t → GDT.Tmin N m ∣ t

name: GDT.Challenge.gdt_periodic
type_pp: ∀ {N m : ℕ}, 0 < N → 0 < m → ∀ {a : ℤ}, GDT.Admissible N m a → GDT.IsPeriod N m a (GDT.Tmin N m)

name: GDT.Challenge.general_divisor_theorem
type_pp:
∀ {N m L : ℕ},
  0 < N →
    0 < m →
      ∀ (a : ℤ),
        (¬GDT.Admissible N m a → GDT.S N L m a = ∅) ∧
          (GDT.Admissible N m a →
              GDT.IsPeriod N m a (GDT.Tmin N m) ∧
                (∀ (t : ℕ), 0 < t → GDT.IsPeriod N m a t → GDT.Tmin N m ∣ t) ∧
                  ∀ (b : ℕ),
                    (Finset.filter (GDT.accepted N m a) (Finset.Ico b (b + GDT.Tmin N m))).card = (GDT.R N m).totient) ∧
            (GDT.R N m).totient * N * (GDT.d N m).totient = GDT.d N m * GDT.R N m * N.totient

name: GDT.Challenge.periodic_window_card_eq
type_pp:
∀ {P : ℕ → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred P] {T : ℕ},
  (∀ (n : ℕ), P (n + T) ↔ P n) →
    ∀ (b : ℕ), (Finset.filter P (Finset.Ico b (b + T))).card = (Finset.filter P (Finset.Ico 0 T)).card

          n2 < GDT.Tmin N m → ↑n1 ≡ a [ZMOD ↑m] → ↑n2 ≡ a [ZMOD ↑m] → n1 % GDT.R N m = n2 % GDT.R N m → n1 = n2
